articles.title: Burnham to hold security talks with German chancellor in Berlin
articles.description: Downing Street said deeper co-operation in the face of rising hybrid threats from Russia would be high on the agenda during Burnham's first official visit to Germany.

articles.title: Syrian general accused of atrocities paid and protected by US and Lebanon, BBC finds
articles.description: Bassam al-Hassan, linked to reporter Austin Tice's abduction, is being sheltered in return for information.

articles.title: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
articles.description: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

articles.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' will continue
articles.description: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
